summary: Cenovus Energy filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) disclosing a definitive arrangement agreement to acquire Athabasca Oil Corporation for $12.00 per share in cash and stock, implying enterprise value of $5.7 billion. Athabasca shareholders may elect cash, 0.264 Cenovus shares, or a mix, subject to proration caps of $4.3 billion cash (75%) and 44.4 million shares (35%), resulting in 65-75% cash and 25-35% stock. The board unanimously recommends the deal. Funding uses cash on hand and short-term borrowings; $85 million annual synergies targeted. Watch regulatory approvals, shareholder election proration, and dissenting shareholder risk.
